purpose: Deterministic 10,000-decision CPU LLAPI transport reference and throughput measurement; this is not training or model inference.

actions.mask_rule: Only outward movement at a boundary and submit in a truncation-only episode are mechanically unavailable.

measurement.scope: CPU Unity/Python LLAPI action-to-step round trips for the registered deterministic trace

comparison.rule: The canonical traces must be structurally and numerically identical for the same base seed; timing is recorded separately and excluded from trace equality.
